source.albedo: [C] Solaimanian & Kennedy 1993 (TRR 1417 pp. 1-11): surface absorptivity of asphalt mixtures typically 0.85-0.93, typical value 0.9 used for the SHRP model -> albedo 0.10
source.emissivity: [C] Solaimanian & Kennedy 1993: emissivity in the same narrow range, typical 0.9
source.layer.k_w_mk: [C] Solaimanian & Kennedy 1993: typical asphalt concrete conductivity 1.38 W/(m K) (range 0.74-2.89, Highter & Wall 1984)
source.layer.rho_c_j_m3k: [C] Yavuzturk & Ksaibati 2002 (MPC 02-136) Table 1: volumetric specific heat 2,000 kJ/(m3 K) for typical asphalt; cross-check [D] Kallas 1966 core bulk specific gravity 2.281 x 880 J/(kg K) = 2.0e6
source.layer.depth_m: [AS] a 0.20 m bound asphalt layer (Kallas 1966's College Park section was 12 in = 0.305 m full depth)
source.deep: [AS] granular base / subgrade soil within the moist sandy/clay soil ranges of Oke 1987 Table 2.1 [M, not re-checked]; column bottom at 2.0 m [AS: > 10 diurnal damping depths of asphalt, sqrt(2 k / (rho_c omega)) = 0.13 m [D]], held at the climate's ground_temp_c
source.mtd_mm: [AS] 0.8 mm mean texture depth, mid of the dense-graded asphalt range (0.5-1.2 mm) the Gallaway/PIARC forms expect
source.drainage: [AS] L = 7.3 m (a 7.3 m half carriageway to the drain) and S = 2.5 % crossfall; Gallaway et al. 1979 [C] take exactly these in their worked example
source.friction.wet: [D] Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, peak wet asphalt 0.5-0.7 and dry 0.8-0.9: 0.6 / 0.85 = 0.71
source.friction.wet_grass: [D] Cenek/Jamieson/McLarin wet/dry locked-wheel ratio (vault RACE-002), mean of 0.81/0.58/0.63 = 0.67

source.albedo: [M] Oke 1987 Table 2.1: concrete 0.10-0.35, mid-range value 0.25 [AS] - not re-checked in W5
source.layer: [M] Oke 1987 Table 2.1 dense concrete: rho 2.40 Mg/m3, c 0.88 kJ/(kg K), C 2.11 MJ/(m3 K), k 1.51 W/(m K) - not re-checked; depth [AS]
source.mtd_mm: [AS] 0.6 mm, a smoother concrete kerb than the carriageway
source.drainage: [AS] kerb to drain: shorter path and flatter fall than the carriageway
source.friction: [AS] as asphalt; wet slightly lower (smoother concrete)

source.albedo: [M] Oke 1987 Table 2.1: soils dark/wet 0.05 to light/dry 0.40; 0.20 [AS] for a packed dirt track
source.layer: [AS] moist sandy soil inside Oke 1987 Table 2.1's dry-to-saturated range (k 0.30-2.20 W/(m K), C 1.28-2.96 MJ/(m3 K)) [M]; W5 has no soil moisture, so the values are fixed
source.soil: [M] Rawls et al. 1982 / Clapp & Hornberger 1978 sandy-loam order: K_sat ~ 15 mm/h, field capacity ~ 0.25, saturation ~ 0.45 [C, not re-checked]; W6 fills the top 0.1 m
source.friction.wet: [D] Wong p. 26: wet earth 0.55 / dry earth 0.68 = 0.81, applied to the class dry lambda (dirt 0.6 in surfaces.json)

source.albedo: [M] Oke 1987 Table 2.1 soils range; 0.18 [AS] for a ploughed field
source.layer: [AS] loose (ploughed) moist soil: lower k and C than the packed dirt, inside Oke 1987 Table 2.1's ranges [M]
source.soil: [M] Rawls et al. 1982 loam order: K_sat ~ 20 mm/h, field capacity ~ 0.28, saturation ~ 0.48 [C, not re-checked]
source.friction: [AS] as dirt (wet earth); the crop canopy is the grass class

source.albedo: [M] Oke 1987 Table 2.1: grass long (1.0 m) 0.16 to short (0.02 m) 0.26; 0.22 [AS]
source.layer: [AS] the root-zone soil under the turf, as dirt.layer; W5 has no canopy layer and no evapotranspiration, so grass runs warmer than real in sunshine (latent heat arrives with W6)
source.soil: [M] Rawls et al. 1982 sandy loam as dirt [C, not re-checked]
source.canopy.capacity_mm: [AS] 0.5 mm canopy interception storage, inside the grass/crop 0.2-1 mm range (interception literature)
source.friction.wet_grass: [D] Cenek/Jamieson/McLarin wet/dry ratio (vault RACE-002), mean 0.67, applied to the class dry lambda (grass 0.42 in surfaces.json)

low_mu.source: the test-ground ice rink (data/surfaces/surfaces.json): no condition state, weather plan 4.1

source.purpose: Default surface classes for data/surfaces/surfaces.json (weather plan W5/W6, docs/data_formats/surface_conditions.md). W5 thermal + W6 water/friction; the snow/ice/crr fields of W8+ are not in the format yet.
source.marks: [C] cited and read, [D] derived, [M] from memory of a named source, not re-checked in this increment, [AS] assumed
